quoted_tweet.text:
your engineer just arrived.

introducing epoch v1.

epoch is your own unattended software engineer, built on Aeon.

customizable, controllable, and yours to run on your own codebase.

give it software work and leave it running.

epoch understands your codebase, builds a feature map, turns goals into plans, breaks work into units, and executes them ,including parallel work when safe and isolated environments.

it reviews its work independently, repairs what breaks, verifies the result, proves what it claims, and keeps watching after the PR opens.

it remembers the project what it learned, what changed, what worked, what failed, and what needs to happen next.

and it can use that knowledge to improve the way it works, improve its workflows, and improve the project itself over time.

you control what it builds, what it can touch, and what done means.

you own the engineer.

built on @aeonframework . designed to be your engineer.

and with aeon Connect, you can now create and drive your own aeon directly from the browser.

give it work. leave it running.
